briefdescription.para: AUTH-Auth-01 — A JWT whose third segment (signature) is empty is structurally malformed and must be rejected with JWT_INVALID_FORMAT.
AUTH-Auth-02 — A token whose exp claim is in the past must be rejected. The validator should raise an error rather than returning valid claims.

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: craft a three-part "JWT" with exp=1 (Unix epoch + 1 second) so it is always expired. The signature verification will fail first or the expiry check will fire — either way the call must not succeed.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Auth-03 — When require_issuer_validation=true the validator must reject a token whose iss claim does not match expected_issuer.
AUTH-Auth-04 — When require_audience_validation=true the validator must reject a token whose aud claim does not match expected_audience.
AUTH-Auth-05 — SAMLAuthenticator::processResponse() must reject an empty Base64 SAML response string without crashing.
AUTH-Auth-06 — MTLSAuthenticator::authenticate() must reject an empty PEM string and throw rather than returning bogus claims.
AUTH-Auth-07 — Constructing JWTValidator with a config that has require_issuer_validation=true but no expected_issuer set must throw AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID at construction time.
AUTH-Auth-08 — When require_jti=true the validator must reject a token that does not contain a "jti" claim.

detaileddescription.para: The token payload intentionally omits "jti"; expiry is set to the far future to ensure the rejection is about the missing claim, not expiry.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-AuthZ-01 — A default-constructed PolicyEvaluationResult must carry PolicyDecision::NOT_APPLICABLE so that a policy with no opinion does not accidentally ALLOW or DENY.
AUTH-AuthZ-02 — A PolicyEvaluationResult can be constructed with ALLOW and an accompanying reason string; both must round-trip.
AUTH-AuthZ-03 — A default-constructed SubjectAttributes must have an empty role field. Policy rules that depend on role membership must not accidentally match against an uninitialised value.
AUTH-AuthZ-04 — resource_type in ResourceAttributes must accept arbitrary string values and preserve them without truncation.
AUTH-AuthZ-05 — is_mfa_verified in EnvironmentAttributes must default to false so that policies requiring MFA deny by default when no environment context is supplied.
AUTH-AuthZ-06 — A default-constructed SubjectAttributes must have an empty groups vector. Group-membership policies must not fire against uninitialised data.
AUTH-AuthZ-07 — A PolicyEvaluationResult set to DENY must preserve both the decision and the associated reason string for audit logging.
AUTH-AuthZ-08 — The classification field in ResourceAttributes must accept standard data sensitivity labels and preserve them correctly.
Verifies SubjectAttributes tenant_id and clearance_level are settable.
Verifies PolicyEvaluationResult applicable_policies list is settable.
AUTH-Provider-01 — Validating a token whose issuer is not registered must throw AuthException with FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM.

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: register no realms, then call validateToken() with a token carrying a recognisable iss claim. The manager must fail-closed.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Provider-02 — After a successful addRealm() the manager must report the new realm in realmCount() and hasRealm().

AUTH-Provider-03 — An OIDC realm whose issuer_url uses plain HTTP rather than HTTPS must be rejected. The expected error is AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID (configuration contract violation) or PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH (TLS not configured).

detaileddescription.para: Per auth_principal_contract.h §6: "Provider configuration declares a capability that the runtime environment cannot satisfy."

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Provider-04 — When the OIDCProvider backend throws a generic network or discovery error, FederatedIdentityManager must wrap it as PROVIDER_DEGRADED (fail-closed per auth_principal_contract.h §6).

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: register a realm backed by an HTTP GET function that always throws std::runtime_error (simulating network failure), then call validateToken() with a token from that issuer.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Provider-05 — removeRealm() must remove the realm from the registry and return true; a subsequent hasRealm() must return false.
AUTH-Provider-06 — exchangeToken() with a subject_token whose issuer is not registered must throw FEDERATION_UNKNOWN_REALM before any token exchange network call is made.
AUTH-RateLimit-01 — The very first authentication attempt from a user must be allowed regardless of the configured threshold.
AUTH-RateLimit-02 — Once the per-user rate-limit threshold is crossed, subsequent attempts from the same user must be blocked.

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: exhaust the threshold with allowAuthAttempt() calls and assert that at least one is eventually denied.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-RateLimit-03 — After the rate-limit window expires the user must be allowed to authenticate again.

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: use a limiter with max_attempts_per_user_per_minute=1 and record a failed attempt so the first window is consumed. After sleeping past the window duration (≈ 1/60 of a minute ≈ very short for tests) we call reset() to simulate window expiry and confirm the attempt is allowed.
Note: The internal token-bucket window granularity may be coarser than milliseconds. We therefore use reset() to deterministically clear state rather than sleeping for 60 seconds.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-RateLimit-04 — Exhausting the rate limit for user A must not affect user B's ability to authenticate.
AUTH-RateLimit-05 — After reset() the limiter must behave as if no prior attempts were recorded; the first attempt is allowed again.

AUTH-RateLimit-06 — Under concurrent load from multiple threads for the same user, the total number of ALLOWED attempts must not far exceed the configured threshold. The limiter must remain free of data races (verified by TSAN when enabled).

detaileddescription.para: We check a soft bound: allowed ≤ threshold * kSlackFactor. A small slack factor accounts for racing window resets in token-bucket implementations.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Token-01 — createSession() must return a non-empty, "sess_"- prefixed session identifier for a valid user.
AUTH-Token-02 — A freshly created session must validate as valid and carry the correct user_id.
AUTH-Token-03 — A session whose absolute_timeout is exceeded must be treated as expired (valid=false) on subsequent validation.

detaileddescription.para: Strategy: construct a SessionManager with a 1 ms absolute_timeout, create a session, sleep briefly, then validate — it must be expired.

briefdescription.para: AUTH-Token-04 — After terminateSession() the session must no longer validate as valid.
AUTH-Token-05 — pruneExpired() must remove sessions whose absolute lifetime has elapsed and reduce size() accordingly.
AUTH-Token-06 — After add(jti, future_expiry) the blacklist must return isRevoked(jti) == true for that JTI.
AUTH-Token-07 — isRevoked() must return false for a JTI that was never added to the blacklist.
AUTH-Token-08 — When max_sessions_per_user is exceeded the oldest session must be evicted so the total for that user stays at the limit; the new session is always created successfully.
Edge Case: Token size exceeds MAX_JWT_TOKEN_SIZE (16KB) Expected: Rejection before any cryptographic processing.
Edge Case: Empty token string Expected: Immediate rejection.
Edge Case: Token with only "Bearer " prefix Expected: Rejection (malformed artifact).
Edge Case: Token at exact size boundary (16KB) Expected: Should be accepted for further validation.
Edge Case: Clock skew tolerance boundary (±60 seconds) Expected: Token with exp at now + 30s should be accepted within skew window.
Edge Case: Session absolute timeout (30 days max) Expected: Enforced per auth_principal_contract.h § 2.
Edge Case: JTI present and blacklist reports revoked Expected: Token rejected with InvalidCredential failure class.
Edge Case: JTI present but blacklist not configured Expected: Token proceeds without JTI revocation check (no rejection).
Edge Case: Token missing JTI when blacklist is required Expected: May warn once (lazy), but continue validation.
Edge Case: Malformed token format (not 3 dot-separated parts) Expected: AuthFailureClass::MalformedArtifact.
Edge Case: Invalid Base64URL encoding in token Expected: AuthFailureClass::MalformedArtifact.
Edge Case: Expired token Expected: AuthFailureClass::ExpiredCredential.
Edge Case: Revoke and check KID status Expected: isKidRevoked returns true after revocation.
Edge Case: Multiple KID revocations Expected: All revoked KIDs are tracked.
Edge Case: Empty KID revocation Expected: Empty string handled gracefully.
Edge Case: scope claim as space-separated string Expected: Parsed into individual scope vectors.
Edge Case: scope claim as JSON array Expected: Preserved as-is in scopes vector.
Edge Case: Empty scopes Expected: Empty vector.
Edge Case: validateAsync on uninitialized thread pool Expected: std::future holds InternalError exception.
Edge Case: validateAsync with null/empty token Expected: std::future holds MalformedArtifact exception.
Edge Case: Missing required_issuer_validation but no issuer set Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Missing required_audience_validation but no audience set Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: JWKS timeout configuration limits Expected: Timeout bounds are enforced.
Edge Case: Max retries configuration Expected: Retry count is bounded.
Edge Case: Derive key with empty DEK Expected: Should handle gracefully or throw.
Edge Case: Derive key with valid inputs Expected: Returns non-empty key bytes.
Edge Case: Derive key with very long field name Expected: Handled without truncation errors.
Edge Case: User has matching group in encryption context Expected: hasAccess returns true.
Edge Case: User lacks group in encryption context Expected: hasAccess returns false.
Edge Case: Encryption context is user subject Expected: hasAccess returns true.
Edge Case: Empty claims Expected: hasAccess returns false.
Edge Case: Token isExpired check at exact expiration time Expected: isExpired returns true when now > exp.
Edge Case: Future token not expired Expected: isExpired returns false.
Edge Case: Past token expired Expected: isExpired returns true.
Edge Case: Empty SP Entity ID Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Empty SP ACS URL Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Empty IdP SSO URL Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Empty IdP Entity ID Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Invalid/malformed certificate PEM Expected: Throw at construction.
Edge Case: Clock skew set to negative value Expected: Accepted (implementation-defined behavior).
Edge Case: Replay cache size set to zero Expected: Accepted but disables replay detection.
Edge Case: Build AuthnRequest with empty relay state Expected: Returns valid URL with SAMLRequest parameter.
Edge Case: Build AuthnRequest with non-empty relay state Expected: URL includes both SAMLRequest and RelayState.
Edge Case: Build AuthnRequest with very long relay state (>80 chars) Expected: Handled gracefully (truncation or encoding).
Edge Case: Retrieve both URL and request ID Expected: buildAuthnRequest returns AuthnRequestParams with request_id.
Edge Case: Empty SAMLResponse Expected: Throw AuthException with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Invalid Base64 encoding Expected: Throw AuthException with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Malformed XML after Base64 decode Expected: Throw AuthException with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: SAMLResponse with Status != Success Expected: Throw AuthException with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Process response with InResponseTo validation Expected: Validates request_id against response InResponseTo.
Edge Case: Same AssertionID within cache TTL Expected: Second occurrence rejected as replay.
Edge Case: AssertionID cache exceeds max_replay_cache_size Expected: Old entries evicted, new ones added.
Edge Case: AssertionID expires after NotOnOrAfter Expected: Duplicate ID allowed after expiry.
Edge Case: Assertion NotBefore in future within clock skew Expected: Accepted.
Edge Case: Assertion NotBefore too far in future Expected: Rejected.
Edge Case: Assertion NotOnOrAfter in past within clock skew Expected: Accepted.
Edge Case: Assertion NotOnOrAfter too far in past Expected: Rejected (expired).
Edge Case: SAMLResponse not signed when required Expected: Throw with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Assertion not signed when required Expected: Throw with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Signature verification with wrong key Expected: Throw with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Signature algorithm mismatch Expected: May be rejected depending on config.
Edge Case: SHA-1 signature when allow_sha1_deprecated=true Expected: Accepted but logged warning.
Edge Case: SHA-1 signature when allow_sha1_deprecated=false Expected: Rejected.
Edge Case: Email attribute extraction with custom name Expected: Extracted correctly from configured attribute name.
Edge Case: Missing email attribute Expected: Empty email in claims.
Edge Case: Multiple values for single-valued attribute Expected: First value used or error.
Edge Case: Groups and roles attributes Expected: Extracted into attributes_groups and attributes_roles vectors.
Edge Case: Issuer matches configured IdP Entity ID Expected: Accepted.
Edge Case: Issuer does not match Expected: Rejected with SAML_INVALID_RESPONSE.
Edge Case: Empty Issuer in response Expected: Rejected.
Edge Case: Audience includes SP Entity ID Expected: Accepted.
Edge Case: Audience does not include SP Entity ID Expected: Rejected.
Edge Case: No AudienceRestriction in assertion Expected: Accepted (no restriction enforced).
Edge Case: Valid RP with all fields populated Expected: Authenticator initializes successfully.
Edge Case: Empty RP ID Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_CONFIG_INVALID).
Edge Case: Empty RP name (optional) Expected: Should be accepted.
Edge Case: Very long RP name Expected: Accepted (no truncation).
Edge Case: Set expected origin explicitly Expected: Overrides default HTTPS://{rp.id} origin.
Edge Case: Attach audit logger Expected: Non-owning pointer stored.
Edge Case: Challenge generation returns 32 random bytes base64url Expected: Challenge string is non-empty, valid base64url, decodable to 32 bytes.
Edge Case: Consecutive challenges are different (randomness) Expected: Two consecutive calls produce different challenges.
Edge Case: Challenge expires after TTL (300 seconds) Expected: verifyAndConsumeChallenge throws after expiry.
Edge Case: Challenge purging removes all expired entries Expected: After purgeExpiredChallenges(), only valid challenges remain.
Edge Case: Start registration with resident key disabled Expected: CredentialCreationOptions.authenticator_selection.require_resident_key = false.
Edge Case: Start registration with resident key enabled Expected: CredentialCreationOptions.authenticator_selection.require_resident_key = true.
Edge Case: CredentialCreationOptions contains supported algorithms Expected: pub_key_cred_params includes ["ES256", "RS256"].
Edge Case: User presence (UP) flag mandatory Expected: completeRegistration throws if UP flag not set in attestation.
Edge Case: Complete registration with invalid challenge Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete registration with wrong origin Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete registration with wrong RP ID Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete registration with unsupported key algorithm Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_NOT_IMPLEMENTED).
Edge Case: Start authentication without specifying user_id Expected: Returns CredentialRequestOptions with empty allow_credentials.
Edge Case: Start authentication with user_id specified Expected: Returns CredentialRequestOptions (caller populates allow_credentials).
Edge Case: Complete authentication with invalid challenge Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete authentication with signature counter rollback Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID) – cloned token detected.
Edge Case: Complete authentication with same counter (invalid) Expected: May be rejected (counter must increment).
Edge Case: Complete authentication with counter increment Expected: Accepted and counter updated.
Edge Case: Complete authentication with wrong origin Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete authentication with wrong RP ID Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: Complete authentication with bad signature Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
Edge Case: Complete authentication missing UP flag Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
Edge Case: ES256 signature verification with valid signature Expected: verifySignature completes without exception.
Edge Case: ES256 signature verification with invalid signature Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
Edge Case: RS256 signature verification with valid signature Expected: verifySignature completes without exception.
Edge Case: RS256 signature verification with invalid signature Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
Edge Case: ECDSA signature with short (truncated) signature Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INVALID_CREDENTIALS).
Edge Case: Parse COSE key to DER SPKI for ES256 Expected: Returns DER-encoded SPKI + "ES256" algorithm.
Edge Case: Parse COSE key to DER SPKI for RS256 Expected: Returns DER-encoded SPKI + "RS256" algorithm.
Edge Case: Parse unsupported COSE key algorithm Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_NOT_IMPLEMENTED).
Edge Case: Parse "none" attestation format Expected: fmt = "none", auth_data extracted.
Edge Case: Parse "packed" attestation format Expected: fmt = "packed", signature verified.
Edge Case: Invalid CBOR attestation object Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR).
Edge Case: Parse valid clientDataJSON Expected: type, challenge, origin extracted correctly.
Edge Case: ClientDataJSON with type="webauthn.create" Expected: Accepted for registration ceremony.
Edge Case: ClientDataJSON with type="webauthn.get" Expected: Accepted for authentication ceremony.
Edge Case: ClientDataJSON with wrong type Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID).
Edge Case: ClientDataJSON missing required fields Expected: Throw AuthException(AUTH_INTERNAL_ERROR).
Edge Case: Parse authenticator data with attested credential Expected: has_attested_credential = true, aaguid populated.
Edge Case: Parse authenticator data without attested credential Expected: has_attested_credential = false, aaguid empty.
Edge Case: Parse UP flag (User Presence) Expected: UP flag (bit 0) always set.
Edge Case: Parse sign counter Expected: Counter value extracted and used for rollback detection.
Edge Case: setRandBytesForTesting with valid function Expected: Challenge generation uses injected randomness.
Edge Case: Deterministic challenges with fixed RNG Expected: Same user/seed produces same challenge.
